proof.python:
import json
import statistics
import time
from pathlib import Path

from stringi._na import NA, is_na
from stringi.collate import s_ne

base = [
    'hladny',
    'chladny',
    'Mario',
    'mario',
    'Mário',
    'mário',
    'number2',
    'number100',
    'a',
    'A',
    'b',
    'B',
    NA,
    '',
    'NA',
    '\ufeffabc',
    'abc',
    'ą',
    'ff',
    'ﬀ',
    'cote',
    'côte',
    'coté',
    'côté',
    'Gärtner',
    'Gaertner',
    'above mentioned',
    'above-mentioned',
    '10',
    '2',
    '100',
    'ß',
    'groß',
    'GROSS',
]
left = base * 50
right = base[::-1] * 50


def plain(value):
    if value is NA or is_na(value):
        return None
    if isinstance(value, bytes):
        return list(value)
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [plain(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {key: plain(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    return value

def one():
    return {
        "main": s_ne(left, right),
        "short": s_ne(["a", "b", "A", "\ufeffa", NA], ["b", "b", "a", "a", "a"]),
    }

Path("/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/stringi/docs/output/%s!=%-python.txt").write_text("s_ne([\"a\"], [\"A\"]) returns TRUE." + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
value = plain(one())
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}, ensure_ascii=False))

proof.r:
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringi))
stopifnot(as.character(packageVersion("stringi")) == "1.8.9")
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(jsonlite))


example <- "ab" %s*% 3
writeLines(
  paste0("'ab' %s*% 3 returns ", example, "."),
  "/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/stringi/docs/output/%s*%-r.txt"
)

one <- function() {
  list(
    rep = "ab" %s*% 3,
    na = c("a", NA) %s*% 2,
    seq = "a" %s*% 1:5,
    text = c("NA", NA) %s*% 2
  )
}

value <- one()
elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
cat(paste0(as.character(toJSON(list(value = value, median_ms = median(elapsed) * 1000), auto_unbox = TRUE, na = "null", digits = 16)), "\n"))

suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(stringi))
stopifnot(identical(as.character(packageVersion("stringi")), "1.8.9"))

json_str <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) return("null")
  chars <- utf8ToInt(enc2utf8(x))
  if (length(chars) == 0) return("\"\"")
  parts <- character(length(chars))
  for (i in seq_along(chars)) {
    cp <- chars[[i]]
    parts[[i]] <- if (cp == 34L) "\\\""
      else if (cp == 92L) "\\\\"
      else if (cp == 10L) "\\n"
      else if (cp == 13L) "\\r"
      else if (cp == 9L) "\\t"
      else if (cp < 32L || cp == 127L || cp > 126L) sprintf("\\u%04x", cp)
      else intToUtf8(cp)
  }
  paste0('"', paste(parts, collapse = ""), '"')
}

json_lgl <- function(x) {
  if (is.na(x)) "null" else if (isTRUE(x)) "true" else "false"
}

one <- function() stri_trans_nfc(c("a\u0301", "\u00e1", NA_character_, ""))

elapsed <- numeric(20)
for (i in seq_len(20)) {
  t0 <- as.numeric(Sys.time())
  one()
  elapsed[[i]] <- as.numeric(Sys.time()) - t0
}
encoded <- if (is.character(value)) vapply(value, json_str, "") else vapply(value, json_lgl, "")
cat(sprintf(
  '{"value":[%s],"median_ms":%.17g}\n',
  paste(encoded, collapse = ","),
  median(elapsed) * 1000
))

out_path <- file.path(dirname(dirname(normalizePath(script))), "docs", "output", "stri_trans_nfc-r.txt")
dir.create(dirname(out_path), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

  "stri_trans_nfc of a followed by a combining acute returns ",
  paste(sprintf("U+%04X", utf8ToInt(got)), collapse = " "),

), out_path)

import json
import statistics
import time
from pathlib import Path

from stringi._na import NA


def plain(value):
    if value is NA:
        return None
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return [plain(item) for item in value]
    if isinstance(value, dict):
        return {key: plain(item) for key, item in value.items()}
    return value



from stringi.wrap import stri_wrap

s = (
    "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet, consectetur adipisicing elit. Proin "
    "nibh augue, suscipit a, scelerisque sed, lacinia in, mi. Cras vel "
    "lorem. Etiam pellentesque aliquet tellus."
)
Path("/home/ahmed/killr_projects/killr/packages/stringi/docs/output/stri_wrap-python.txt").write_text(
    f"stri_wrap(s, 20, 0) returns {len(stri_wrap(s, 20, 0, locale='en_US'))} lines.\n"
)


def one():
    return {
        "greedy": stri_wrap(s, 20, 0, locale="en_US"),
        "dynamic": stri_wrap(s, 20, 2, locale="en_US"),
        "indent": stri_wrap(
            s, 24, 0, indent=2, exdent=4, prefix="> ", initial="* ", normalize=False, locale="en_US"
        ),
        "ws": stri_wrap("hello   world  wide", 10, 0, whitespace_only=True, normalize=False, locale="en_US"),
        "cjk": stri_wrap("一一 一一 一", 4, 0, use_length=False, normalize=False, locale="en_US"),
        "emoji": stri_wrap("a😀 b cd", 3, 0, normalize=False, locale="en_US"),
        "norm": stri_wrap("hello\nworld  there", 10, 0, normalize=True, locale="en_US"),
        "missing": stri_wrap(["ab cd ef", NA], 4, 0, normalize=False, locale="en_US"),
    }

value = plain(one())
elapsed = []
for _ in range(20):
    started = time.perf_counter()
    one()
    elapsed.append((time.perf_counter() - started) * 1000)
print(json.dumps({"value": value, "median_ms": statistics.median(elapsed)}, ensure_ascii=False))
